column1: # scripts/autoresolve-paths.tsv: the generated files scripts/pr-autoresolve.sh may resolve when merging main into a
# pull request. A conflict in any other path stops it. One row per path (a shell glob), then the recipe that rebuilds
# it over the merged tree (pr-autoresolve.sh's `regen`). scripts/pr_autoresolve_test.go holds the matcher.
